answers.2_canAConflictDisappearBeforeDurability: No — every distinct valid IPC report is an immutable durable candidate; a repeated identical report is idempotent
answers.3_canMixedInvocationSetBeCalledSelectedU: No — SELECTED_UNIQUE requires that no other Invocation exists at all
answers.4_canEventReadRaceProduceStaleAttributed: No — a bounded post-Event-Read relevant-basis recheck yields RACED with no admitted events
answers.5_canTimeoutAbortFinalizeAnUnclosedInvoc: No — only a Parent-observed DIRECT_CHILD_EXIT_OBSERVED finalizes; a timeout/abort leaves the window incomplete
answers.6_canOneJobFinalizeAnotherInvocation: No — finalization is Invocation-scoped; finalizeAttempt no longer records CLOSED for every invocation
answers.7_isCanonicalWorkHistoryPreserved: Yes — the attributed Preview reuses the existing canonicalFactsOf; result, verification, promotion and rework stay separate
answers.8_isProjectEvolutionPreserved: Yes — the product cluster wires projectEvolutionOf over composeTrajectoryInputs; a failure is reported with its structured origin
answers.9_canAnEphemeralRecordBecomeDurableAutho: No — an in-memory store yields durability EPHEMERAL on the qualification and the Capsule
answers.10_doesAwaitedDisposalReallyAwaitReaderC: Yes — OwnedResource.close may return a promise and the lifecycle awaits it
answers.11_isTheCapsuleAttemptBound: Yes — the consumer's permission is its own canonical governed-rework lineage
answers.12_canACallerRequestArbitrarySessionHist: No — a requested origin must agree with the lineage; an unpermitted origin is refused; there is no global Session lookup
answers.13_canHistoricalPromptInjectionTextAutho: No — the Capsule is HISTORICAL_DATA_NOT_INSTRUCTIONS with authority READ_ONLY_INSPECTION and seven explicit non-authorizations
answers.14_didRealFirstPartyDshRunWithoutAModelT: Yes — the cold-capsule gate creates a real Session and reads it with zero model turns
answers.18_hasActualAgentUtilityBeenMeasured: No — this is a D1 question; D0 only prepared the protocol

disclosedLimitations: Node v24.14.1 < the documented >=24.15.0 minimum; the only runtime available on this host
the source basis hashes executable PATH strings, so it is a local trusted-composition boundary, not content attestation
the cross-Attempt conflict scope is the adapter id and worker-bin digest, not the sessions root on disk
the reader is composed only when the host supplies DSH_HOME; the supported default-home behavior is recorded as a limitation
the Capsule AUTHORIZED lineage path is proven at the controlled level; the real-DSH gate proves the bounded projection and the refusal of an arbitrary attempt
the post-read currentness recheck is a bounded optimistic read-check, not a distributed transaction
full product historical-epoch management is outside the bounded D0 scope
